products.name: Viper Fang MK-I
products.description: A lightweight wireless mouse built for speed. The Fang MK-I pairs a gunmetal shell with a low-latency optical sensor, so every flick lands where you aimed it. Silver accents trace the chassis, lit from beneath by a thread of Viper green.

products.name: Viper Strike TKL
products.material: Brushed aluminum top plate, hot-swappable switches
products.description: A tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with a brushed silver top plate and hot-swappable switches underneath. Per-key green backlighting runs edge to edge, dimming and flaring with every keystroke.

products.name: Viper Coilbed XL
products.description: An extended-format mousepad with a stitched silver edge and a stealth-woven surface tuned for consistent glide. A faint green Viper coil pattern runs beneath the weave.
